::: {.callout-note}
## Known to exist — copy sought
A 1990 ECPM training manual is independently cited in a public annotated bibliography inspected for this catalogue. This archive has **not** inspected the manual. A possible 1994 training revision remains an open question: no independent title-page or catalogue record for a 1994 edition was found. Emma Van der Klift is **not** named on the public citations inspected here.
:::

| Element | Evidence and source of the statement |
| --- | --- |
| Title as cited in 1997/98 bibliography | “Enhanced Consumer Participation Model: Skill Development Manual for Consumers of Home Support Services” |

| Date as cited there | 1990 |
| Extent as cited there | “A training manual that includes 5 modules intended to empower consumers to act as effective employers (52 pages plus appendices)” |

: Identification

The commissioning issue used the generic heading “Enhanced Consumer Participation Model (ECPM) manual(s).” The title above is the wording of the later public citation, not an inspected title page.

## Annotation

This record may still represent more than one publication. The 1990 *Skill Development Manual* is now bibliographically confirmed by a later public bibliography. That bibliography was inspected; the manual was not.

[Joseph Theriault’s IFRC board biography](ifrc-our-team.qmd) states that he “worked alongside Paul and others as pioneers of the individual funding project; then known as Enhanced Consumer Participation Model [ECPM].” That is a later organizational attribution, not a title-page authorship statement.

No public source inspected here names Emma Van der Klift as an ECPM manual author. Her separately published 1993 and 1994 essays on help and human services are not treated as ECPM manuals.

## Open questions

- Location of a 1990 copy, and whether a 1994 item is a revision, a training manual, or a different work.
- Title-page authors (including whether Van der Klift, Vancouver Health Department, or others appear).
- Relationship to [*Keys on Freedom*](wanted-keys-on-freedom.qmd).
- How ECPM relates, in contemporaneous documents, to 1993–95 CSIL design — later IFRC pages assert a sequence; this archive has not inspected ECPM texts that would test that.
